details: The V3 action result now preserves accepted/failed/partial/unknown/verified state and submitted-write counts. A lost status POST can be reconciled by fresh independent CAD read-back, but a lost CREATE_CALL receipt cannot safely identify a new record and an identical note is not a unique write receipt. Field incident partial notes/deferrals and uncertain notes remain visible and are not blindly retried or declared saved. Compound dependencies stop on uncertain prerequisites and independent reads continue.
boundary: No unique create-call or note idempotency receipt exists in the observed CAD contract and there is no persistent unknown-write ledger across restarts. Therefore unknown submitted creations/notes require human or supported authoritative reconciliation; no automatic retry or atomic rollback is promised. The absence of durable cross-restart reconciliation blocks full live/release guarantees until separately qualified.
